post_install: if (!(is_admin)) { error 'Service registration requires Administrator privileges.'; exit 1 }
if (Get-Service vmagent -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { try { Stop-Service vmagent -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}; & nssm remove vmagent confirm | Out-Null }
& nssm set vmagent DisplayName "VictoriaMetrics Agent (vmagent)" | Out-Null
& nssm set vmagent Description "Collects metrics and sends them to VictoriaMetrics or Prometheus." | Out-Null
& nssm set vmagent Start SERVICE_AUTO_START | Out-Null

if (Test-Path $appParamsFile) { $appParams = (Get-Content -Path $appParamsFile -Raw).Trim(); & nssm set vmagent AppParameters $appParams | Out-Null; Write-Host "Restored AppParameters from persisted file '$appParamsFile': $appParams" -ForegroundColor Yellow }

if (Test-Path $appEnvExtraFile) { $appEnvExtraLines = @(Get-Content -Path $appEnvExtraFile); & nssm set vmagent AppEnvironmentExtra ($appEnvExtraLines -join "`r`n") | Out-Null; Write-Host "Restored AppEnvironmentExtra from persisted file '$appEnvExtraFile':`n$($appEnvExtraLines -join "`n")" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
Write-Host 'Service registered. Configure flags with: nssm edit vmagent' -ForegroundColor Yellow
pre_uninstall: if (!(is_admin)) { error 'Service removal requires Administrator privileges.'; exit 1 }

if ($appParams) { $appParamsFile = "$persistDir\AppParameters.txt"; Set-Content -Path $appParamsFile -Value $appParams -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host "Saved AppParameters to persist directory: $appParamsFile" -ForegroundColor Yellow }

if ($appEnvExtra) { $appEnvExtraFile = "$persistDir\AppEnvironmentExtra.txt"; Set-Content -Path $appEnvExtraFile -Value $appEnvExtra -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host "Saved AppEnvironmentExtra to persist directory: $appEnvExtraFile" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
